quest.title: Drifting Toward a Promised Sky
quest.description: You find a jellyfish collapsed on the ground in a Fatui base. What could've happened to it?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's all limp and floppy... like someone dropped a Valberry Jelly right here on the floor. Paimon nearly didn't notice it when we passed by earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It doesn't seem to have noticed us... Is it taking a nap?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Jellyfish don't have brains, so they probably don't need sleep...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!? N—No brain... There's really a creature with no brain!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But even without a brain, it looks like it can still feel pain... Paimon gets the impression it isn't very happy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've got to get this barrier open and see if it's okay! But how are we supposed to do that?

choices.text: It looks like we need a working brain. So I guess it's on me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph! You make it sound like Paimon's brain doesn't work...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmph! Paimon's just not good at solving puzzles, that's all. But when it comes to finding tasty stuff... you've got nothing on Paimon, {NICKNAME}!

choices.text: If it really was a jelly, you'd know what to do, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: W—We didn't make it in time... Hmm, is Valberry Jelly mourning its friends?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do jellyfish really not have the ability to think? It sure looks sad to Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps emotions don't require thoughts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #You're right, {NICKNAME}. You can't just think your way out of feeling sad.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe feelings like that... just rise up on their own, from somewhere deep inside us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You look so sad... No tears, no words, not even a sound... Poor thing. What can we do to make you feel better?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There might be other jellyfish that still need our help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y—You're right... So many of them have already... met their jelly molds... The Fatui really don't care at all what happens to them!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This place is huge. There's gotta be tons of those nasty machines around. Valberry Jelly can't be the only one that's been trapped.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go get them all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They seriously left the key right by the door...? The Fatui here aren't exactly the brightest, huh?

choices.text: Since they're the enemy, I'm fine with them being a little stupid.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right! If they were clever and actually tried, we'd never have found that key so easily!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then that jellyfish... Hmm, how about we call it "Valberry Jelly"? ...It might not have made it out in time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, the barrier's open, so why's it still lying there?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The rescued jellyfish tries to move, but its body gives out, and it collapses back onto the ground...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: I—It still looks like it's in pain... Paimon thought it was because of the barrier...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Maybe the kuuvahki is just too weak around here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Are you not sensing much kuuvahki, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You've been sensing it just fine since we arrived in Nod-Krai.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Could it be feeling this way because the environment suddenly changed?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hang in there. We'll find a way to get you out of here!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Come on, {NICKNAME}, think of something!

choices.text: So, you're giving up the second thinking is involved?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Th—That's only because the situation's desperate! That little jelly's just barely hanging on!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It must be because those nasty machines the Fatui set up are totally messing up the environment! Let's shut them all down!

choices.text: Well, if you can't do it, that just leaves me.
You're sharper than all those clueless Fatui, Paimon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That doesn't sound like much of a compliment to Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If Paimon hadn't noticed this little puddle of Valberry Jelly... Hey, that's what we should call it! ...We probably would've missed the chance to save it, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Valberry Jelly is floating! This must be what you're really like, huh? Paimon knew those nasty machines had something to do with it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it trying to lead us somewhere? Let's follow and see.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Valberry Jelly's slipped into that big shell... and ooh, is that something buried under the sand? A thank-you gift, maybe?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww, it really was a gift! Valberry Jelly does have good manners!

choices.text: It seems like you two can communicate just fine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're both good kids with simple hearts. We don't need words to understand each other.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It must want to say, "Thank you for saving me! This beach is full of hidden treasures. Go ahead, please take them all!"

choices.text: I guess I've got no choice but to trust your jellyfish-speak.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What jellyfish-speak...? Paimon told you, no words were needed! And of course you should trust Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then Valberry Jelly can rest here while we check out what treasures are hiding under the sand!

choices.text: Well, if Valberry Jelly insists...
How do you communicate without talking?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You always overthink everything! Paimon and Valberry Jelly are just good kids with simple hearts. We don't need words to understand each other.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's another trapped jellyfish, and it doesn't look healthy. Come on, we've gotta get it out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's a jellyfish buried here! And it's still alive!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So it wanted us to save its friends? Hmm... Paimon completely misunderstood what Valberry Jelly was trying to say...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's one of the Fatui's nasty machines! Shoo, shoo! Paimon's not gonna let you hurt Valberry Jelly!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: W—We didn't make it in time... Hmm, is Valberry Jelly mourning its friends?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do jellyfish really not have the ability to think? It sure looks sad to Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps emotions don't require thoughts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #You're right, {NICKNAME}. You can't just think your way out of feeling sad.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe feelings like that... just rise up on their own, from somewhere deep inside us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You look so sad... No tears, no words, not even a sound... Poor thing. What can we do to make you feel better?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There might be other jellyfish that still need our help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y—You're right... So many of them have already... met their jelly molds... The Fatui really don't care at all what happens to them!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This place is huge. There's gotta be tons of those nasty machines around. We can't let the jellyfish be abandoned on the beach like this!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's certain Valberry Jelly can't be the only jellyfish trapped in this base. Let's go find the others!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Why won't it open? Isn't this the right key...? Hmm, what should we do now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! Paimon didn't know Valberry Jelly had that kind of power. It looks like the rest of this rescue mission's gonna be an easy-peasy piece of cake!

choices.text: But... don't you think it's looking a bit pale?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... You're right, it does look paler now. It looks weaker than before, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did it use up all its strength just now? No, no, that can't be it! Valberry Jelly was already running low on energy...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In the end... W—We still couldn't make it in time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you angry? Or sad? Or not feeling well? Hmm, it doesn't seem like any of those... Ugh, this is so frustrating! How are we supposed to know what it's trying to say?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This seems like a gesture it would only make for one of its own.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Does that mean... even though we couldn't save its friends, it still wants to thank us? Valberry Jelly...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It seems like jellyfish have more heart than the Fatui ever will. Those guys build all those horrible machines, and they don't care about life one bit!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So really, who's the one with no brain?

choices.text: But... It looks way weaker than before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Valberry Jelly... It doesn't even look like itself anymore... Paimon can't believe it used its power again just to help us...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's a gesture it would only make for one of its own.... Is it saying goodbye?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's another one! Awesome, we've got to save it this time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't open that by yourself! We're almost there! Whatever you do, don't use up your strength!

talks.objective: Look for the ID card inside the building

dialogues.speaker: Trapped Jellyfish
dialogues.text: (It seems to have no energy left... It needs to be rescued.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? The barrier suddenly activated! Oh no... we're locked in!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No way... Even Valberry Jelly and the others got knocked to the ground... How dare they!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What do we do now?! We're trapped too. How are we supposed to help the jellies like this...?

choices.text: Don't worry. As long as I'm here, we're sure to get out of this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Being stuck with {NICKNAME} isn't so scary. But Paimon's worried about Valberry Jelly and the others...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm, since Valberry Jelly and Paimon can both fly, th—then maybe Paimon might be able to do the same thing Valberry Jelly did, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's open! It actually opened! Let's go save them!

choices.text: It's not the first time we've encountered trouble, after all. Just stay calm.

dialogues.speaker: Trapped Jellyfish
dialogues.text: (It appears to be trapped inside? Let's see if there's a way to get it out.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sob*... Valberry Jelly... It went back up to the sky to be with its friends...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon heard that when a Tassel Jelly reaches the end of its life, it can start over as a little jellyfish, so long as it makes it back to the sky. Paimon wonders if that's really true...

choices.text: That's probably why it was so desperate to rescue its friends.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, yeah... If they stayed trapped inside those barriers, they wouldn't be able to fly back to the sky.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So those two we saved earlier must be with Valberry Jelly right now, right?

response.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
response.text: We cleared out all those nasty machines, and the environment's back to normal, so there's no need to worry anymore!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmm... {NICKNAME}, do you think it'll remember us when it grows up again?

choices.text: Probably not.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Well, it doesn't have a brain, after all. But maybe it keeps important memories somewhere else instead?

choices.text: Maybe it will.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, Paimon thinks so too! Valberry Jelly will remember us, just like how we'll remember it.

choices.text: We probably wouldn't recognize it either, would we?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's no biggie if it doesn't recognize us! We didn't help it just to be remembered, after all. We'll just introduce ourselves all over again next time!

choices.text: I want to believe it's true.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon wants to believe it, too! After all, Valberry Jelly really did have mysterious powers.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So those two we saved earlier must be with Valberry Jelly right now, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are we supposed to do now?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The Tassel Jelly — which has been quietly floating up to this point — suddenly presses itself against the "Access Confirmation Terminal." A flash of light follows, and the barrier disappears.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: As the light fades, the little jellyfish returns to its gentle floating, though its movements suggest it is much weaker than before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! So it can disable these barriers by itself? That would've been nice to know earlier!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't you agree, Valberry Jelly?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why isn't it responding? We were totally getting along...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Valberry Jelly gives no response to Paimon's question. Its tentacles droop weakly — it looks completely drained...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It looks a lot weaker than before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did it use up all its strength just now? No, no, that can't be it! Valberry Jelly was already running low on energy...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In the end... W—We still couldn't make it in time...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you angry? Or sad? Or not feeling well? Hmm, it doesn't seem like any of those... Ugh, this is so frustrating! How are we supposed to know what it's trying to say?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This seems like a gesture it would only make for one of its own.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Does that mean... even though we couldn't save its friends, it still wants to thank us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It seems like jellyfish have more heart than the Fatui ever will. Those guys build all those horrible machines, and they don't care about life one bit!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So really, who's the one with no brain?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, just thinking about those dumb Fatui getting all flustered when they realize their hidden keys were messed with... it's kinda funny.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... It really does look paler now, and a bit weaker than before, too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But... It looks way weaker than before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? What's going on? That was the switch for this barrier? Then that means, at least the other side...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh! Valberry Jelly dropped to the floor again... It's that nasty machine's fault!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What do we do now?! We're trapped too. How are we supposed to help the jellies like this...?

choices.text: Don't worry. As long as I'm here, we're sure to get out of this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Being stuck with {NICKNAME} isn't so scary. But Paimon's worried about Valberry Jelly and the others...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Look! There's some records here. They might contain a clue!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon was hoping for something to help shut down the barrier, not just a bunch of complaints...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But at least we're not like the Fatuus who wrote this — stuck in here alone.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm, since Valberry Jelly and Paimon can both fly, th—then maybe Paimon might be able to do the same thing Valberry Jelly did, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Uhm... Nothing happened. Paimon guesses she doesn't have the right kind of power. At the very least, Paimon was hoping you could escape, {NICKNAME}...

choices.text: I don't want Paimon to turn pale.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon's pretty sure she's always been kinda pale, but she gets what you mean, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: H—How long are we gonna be trapped like this...? What if we end up just like the jellies, getting weaker and weaker, until we just... Aah! Okay, stop it, stop it, brain! Stop thinking!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! We told you not to do that by yourself! You're still weak, Valberry Jelly!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can't believe it used its power again just to help us... From this point on, it's up to us!

choices.text: I'd never leave you behind, Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, Paimon knows... but if we're both locked in here, doesn't that mean we can't do anything to get out?

choices.text: It's not the first time we've encountered trouble, after all. Just stay calm.
